law_name: Copyright Act, 2014 (Act No. 5 of 2014; in force 1 August 2014; repealed Copyright Act Cap. 58 of 1984)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (anonymous and audiovisual works 50 years from creation or publication; applied art 25 years); section not seen
fair_use_exceptions: Fair dealing exceptions exist (specifics not found); covers traditional cultural expressions and folklore (unconfirmed)
registration_required: No (voluntary registration under 2015 Regulations made under ss. 28(2) and 37)
notes: WTO membership 26 April 2015 per Commons only. No Berne/WCT/WPPT accession found; a 2019 WIPO workshop said Berne ratification was under consideration. Term is conflicting between sources (an old UNESCO page shows 25 years for the repealed 1984 Act).
